title: applications_log line (without timestamp)
description: One application outcome. The runner adds `timestamp` and writes the line; the applier never touches the file.

url.description: The offer URL exactly as given to you in the offer object.

apply_type.description: internal = the portal's own form (justjoin modal, pracuj form); rest as named.

outcome.description: applied_clean = all fields mapped directly, submitted; applied_composed = submitted, >=1 composed free-text; filled_review = filled, stopped for review; blocked = a playbook section 8 trigger.

cv_used.description: Repo-relative path of the PDF you attached, e.g. CV_PDF/CV_Yan_Lukashevich_python_ai/CV_Yan_Lukashevich_EN.pdf. Empty string if none was attached.

composed_answers.description: Every free-text you wrote, verbatim, even in review mode. [] if none.

blocked_reason.description: null unless outcome is blocked. Then one of: captcha | register | missing-fact: <field name> | dead-link

notes.description: Short: what happened, anything the user should know.

diagnostics.description: Required on every line - production's only health signal. Terse and factual, never prose.

ats.description: The form vendor: internal | eRecruiter | Traffit | tomHRM | Workday | ...

workarounds.description: One short line per stall + how you cleared it. [] if none.

left_blank.description: Optional fields you deliberately skipped. [] if none.
